name: Two pointers (left / right)
whenToUse: The standard answer: one pass from both ends, no cleaned copy of the string.

card.signals: "reads the same forward and backward" means the first character must equal the last, the second the second-to-last, and so on. "Removing non-alphanumeric characters" means some characters must be skipped on the way. Both point to two pointers that start at the ends and move towards each other.
card.pattern: two pointers, towards each other: left starts at index 0, right at the last index. Each character is looked at once at most. O(n) time, O(1) extra space.
card.coreIdea: Move each pointer past characters that do not count, then compare the two characters in lowercase. If they differ, it is not a palindrome. If they match, move both inwards. When the pointers meet, every pair has matched.

invariant: Every letter or digit outside [left, right] has already been matched with its mirror partner.

legend.text: left: next character from the front
right: next character from the back
skipped: not a letter or digit
the pair that does not match
